tool: tools/joint_relax.py (joint two-sided aggregation: row-pair agreements a_ij^c tied to column counts, column-pair agreements b_pq^c tied to row counts, color-total identity sum_k z_kc = sum_r w_rc, pigeonhole links a >= w_i + w_j - n / a <= min(w_i, w_j) and transposes; T equal to BOTH views)
